title.ja: Nohの冷たい流入衝撃波：平面・円筒・球対称
title.en: Noh cold-inflow shock: planar, cylindrical and spherical symmetry

assumptions.ja: 理想気体Euler、γ=5/3、初期密度1・内向き速度1・圧力0。r∈[0,1]、t=0.6。平面(d=1)・円筒半径対称(d=2)・球半径対称(d=3)の有限体積計算で、圧力の床は使いません。球のカラー図は1次元半径データの中心断面で、Cartesianの3次元計算ではありません。 別の実2D Cartesian版では[-.5,.5]²の32²/64²/128²格子、2成分運動量と両方向流束を使い、半径還元は行いません。密度参照は衝撃円で分割した64/128点の求積セル平均です。
assumptions.en: Ideal-gas Euler, gamma=5/3, rho0=1, inward speed 1, p0=0; r in [0,1], t=0.6. Planar (d=1), cylindrical-radial (d=2) and spherical-radial (d=3) finite-volume calculations without a pressure floor. The spherical color picture is a central section of one-dimensional radial data, not a Cartesian three-dimensional computation. A separate full-square2D Cartesian calculation uses [-.5,.5]^2 with32²/64²/128² cells, both momenta and no radial reduction. Its density-cell reference is shock-split quadrature, checked at orders64/128.

cases.reference_scope: Analytic continuous solution and independently evaluated ExactPack values. Conserved-volume averages are the FV reference; primitive pressure of a conserved average is distinguished from averaged analytic pressure. The PDE numerical solution is Atlas original code.

name.ja: Noh問題：冷たい収束流と外向き衝撃波
name.en: Noh problem: cold converging flow and outward shock

caption.ja: 実際の2次元Cartesian Euler計算の密度場。正方形全域128²セル、初期圧力ゼロ、γ=5/3、t=.6。白破線は厳密衝撃円。軸・対角方向の差と原点過熱を残し、1D半径例にも辿れます。
caption.en: Density from an actual2D Cartesian Euler computation:full square128²,p0=0,gamma5/3,t=.6. White dashed circle is the exact shock. Axis/diagonal differences and origin heating remain visible, with links to earlier1D radial examples.

name.ja: Noh衝撃波：初期圧力ゼロの平面・円筒・球対称計算
name.en: Noh shocks: zero-pressure planar, cylindrical and spherical flow

scope.ja: 初期圧力ゼロのNoh問題を、独自の小型1D有限体積コードで平面・円筒・球対称に計算します。64/128/256/512格子の全域誤差、原点過熱、衝撃位置、保存収支を測り、球で現れる境界流入の時間積分誤差を解析式と照合します。
scope.en: An original small 1D finite-volume code solves zero-pressure Noh flow in planar, cylindrical and spherical symmetry. Grids 64/128/256/512 measure full-domain error, origin heating, shock location and budgets, and compare spherical boundary-inflow time-quadrature error with its analytic identity.

name.ja: Noh問題：実際の2次元Cartesian Euler計算
name.en: Noh problem: an actual 2D Cartesian Euler calculation

scope.ja: 正方形の全域で密度・2成分運動量・全エネルギーを更新する、小型の2次元Euler有限体積計算です。32²・64²・128²の3格子で厳密Noh状態からの誤差・保存収支・格子方向の影響を測ります。図は実際の2次元保存配列で、1D半径解の回転表示ではありません。
scope.en: A small 2D Euler finite-volume calculation evolves density, both momenta and total energy over the full square. Three grids,32²/64²/128², measure Noh-reference errors, budgets and grid orientation effects. The picture shows the actual evolved 2D array.

note.ja: 同じNoh問題の解析参照。1Dは保存量の厳密体積平均、2Dは衝撃円で分割した密度の求積セル平均を使用します。点値とセル平均、p(平均U)と平均pを区別します。
note.en: Analytic reference for the same Noh problem.1D uses exact conserved-volume means;2D uses density means from shock-split Cartesian cell quadrature. Distinguish points/cell means and p(mean U)/mean p.
